The files are rarely accessed (less than once a year), but when requested, a retrieval time of 12 hours is acceptable. The company wants to minimize ongoing monthly storage costs. Which TWO actions achieve maximum cost optimization? (Select TWO.)
options: Configure an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days.
Configure an S3 Lifecycle rule to permanently delete noncurrent object versions and abort incomplete multipart uploads.
Migrate historical video archive files to Amazon EBS gp3 volumes configured in Multi-Attach mode.
Enable Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on the origin bucket to automatically compress archived video files.
Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the S3 bucket configured with a 1-year Time-To-Live (TTL).

results.question_text: An engineering manager runs stateless batch rendering workloads on EC2 Auto Scaling groups. The workload can tolerate instance terminations. The manager wants to minimize compute costs while reducing the risk of Spot capacity unavailability. Which TWO Spot configuration options should be combined? (Select TWO.)
options: Set the Auto Scaling group Spot Allocation Strategy to price-capacity-optimized to select pools with optimal capacity and price.
Configure Attribute-Based Instance Type Selection in the Auto Scaling group to diversify across multiple instance types and families.
Purchase 3-Year EC2 Dedicated Host Reservations for all Auto Scaling group worker nodes.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to launch strictly On-Demand instances with assigned Elastic IP addresses.
Enable EC2 Termination Protection on all Spot instances within the Auto Scaling group.

results.question_text: A company operates hundreds of EC2 instances in private subnets that transfer petabytes of data monthly to Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB. The current network path routes through NAT Gateways, generating tens of thousands of dollars in NAT data processing charges. Which TWO actions eliminate NAT Gateway data processing charges for S3 and DynamoDB? (Select TWO.)
options: Create a free VPC Gateway Endpoint for Amazon S3 and update private subnet route tables.
Create a free VPC Gateway Endpoint for Amazon DynamoDB and update private subnet route tables.
Replace NAT Gateways with Egress-Only Internet Gateways across all private subnets.
Configure AWS Direct Connect Public Virtual Interfaces (Public VIFs) for all private subnet EC2 traffic.
Enable Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on all company S3 buckets.

results.question_text: A company notices high monthly S3 storage bills caused by incomplete multipart file uploads and noncurrent object versions created by enabled bucket versioning. Which TWO S3 Lifecycle configurations automate the cleanup of these hidden storage costs? (Select TWO.)
options: Add an S3 Lifecycle rule to expire incomplete multipart uploads after a specified number of days.
Add an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition or permanently delete noncurrent object versions after a specified number of days.
Disable S3 Versioning permanently across all company S3 buckets to purge existing noncurrent object versions.
Enable Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on all S3 buckets to automatically compress uncompleted uploads.
Configure S3 Object Lock with MFA Delete enabled to automatically clean up noncurrent object versions.

results.question_text: A company runs containerized batch workloads on Amazon ECS. Some tasks require high CPU/RAM for short durations, while others run continuously 24/7. Which TWO purchasing strategies optimize compute costs across this container infrastructure? (Select TWO.)
options: Use Fargate Spot for fault-tolerant, interruptible batch container tasks to reduce compute costs.
Purchase Compute Savings Plans for baseline 24/7 continuous container workloads to achieve consistent hourly discounts.
Purchase EC2 On-Demand Dedicated Hosts to run all batch and continuous ECS container tasks.
Purchase Amazon DynamoDB Reserved Capacity to offset Fargate compute execution costs for batch processing.
Use AWS Batch with On-Demand EC2 Reserved Instances configured strictly for short-duration interruptible tasks.

results.question_text: An enterprise runs an Amazon Aurora MySQL database and requires cross-Region disaster recovery. The business can tolerate an RPO typically measured in seconds and an RTO measured in minutes after an unplanned outage of the primary Region. Which TWO actions or characteristics correctly implement and describe this solution? (Select TWO.)
options: Create an Aurora Global Database with a secondary cluster in another Region, using low-latency asynchronous storage-based replication between Regions.
During an unplanned outage, initiate a managed cross-Region failover to promote the chosen secondary, accepting possible seconds of data loss and recovery within minutes.
Copy automated database snapshots to another Region and restore them after an outage to achieve an RPO of seconds and recovery within minutes.
Create an independent cross-Region Aurora Replica outside a global database and use managed global failover to promote it during a Regional outage.
Configure synchronous writes to both Regional clusters so every committed transaction is preserved before the secondary is promoted during an unplanned outage.

results.question_text: A web application hosted on EC2 instances in private subnets receives public web traffic through an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The security policy mandates inspecting Layer 7 traffic for SQL injection attacks, enforcing HTTPS encryption in transit, and restricting administrative SSH access to a bastion host. Which THREE security controls fulfill these requirements? (Select THREE.)
options: Associate an AWS WAF Web ACL with the Application Load Balancer to inspect Layer 7 HTTP requests for SQL injection patterns.
Configure an HTTPS Listener on the Application Load Balancer with an SSL/TLS certificate managed by AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).
Configure Security Groups on application EC2 instances to allow inbound SSH (port 22) strictly from the Bastion Host Security Group ID.
Enable AWS Network Firewall on the Application Load Balancer target group to block SQL injection attacks.
Configure egress Network ACLs on private subnets to enforce HTTPS encryption in transit between client browsers and the load balancer.
Configure Amazon GuardDuty Malware Protection on the Application Load Balancer to restrict administrative SSH access.

results.question_text: An enterprise requires a robust disaster recovery and data protection architecture for core AWS workloads. The solution must automate cross-account backup copies, replicate S3 objects to a secondary AWS Region, and automatically route global web traffic to a healthy secondary Region if the primary Region fails. Which THREE components build this resilient solution? (Select THREE.)
options: AWS Backup with scheduled backup plans executing cross-Region and cross-account copy actions into locked vaults.
Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) with Versioning enabled on source and destination buckets.
Amazon Route 53 failover routing with health checks to redirect client traffic from the primary Region to the secondary Region.
AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway deployed in a single Availability Zone to archive S3 object versions.
Amazon EC2 Instance Store volumes attached to application servers for persistent long-term backup data retention.
AWS Transit Gateway Inter-Region Peering with static route tables to automatically reroute client internet traffic.

results.question_text: A media company is building a real-time data streaming analytics pipeline to process clickstream data from millions of mobile users. The pipeline must ingest streaming events continuously, transform JSON records using AWS Lambda, and buffer data into an Amazon Redshift data warehouse for BI reporting. Which THREE AWS services construct this pipeline? (Select THREE.)
options: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams for high-throughput real-time stream ingestion.
Amazon Data Firehose to transform records via AWS Lambda and load data continuously into Amazon Redshift.
Amazon Redshift data warehouse to execute complex SQL analytics queries.
Amazon SQS Standard queues to buffer JSON clickstream records for automated batch insertion into Redshift.
AWS Glue Streaming ETL jobs to write streaming clickstream data directly into Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
Amazon EMR Serverless cluster running Apache Spark Batch jobs to continuously ingest real-time streaming data.

results.question_text: A global e-commerce portal experiences performance bottlenecks due to database read-heavy traffic. The architecture consists of a web tier, an application tier backed by a relational database for order transactions, and Amazon DynamoDB for high-throughput product catalog reads. To achieve sub-millisecond response times, the architect plans multi-tier caching across edge, application, and database layers. Which THREE caching services fulfill this strategy? (Select THREE.)
options: Amazon CloudFront at the edge layer for caching static web assets and dynamic content.
Amazon ElastiCache for Redis at the application tier for caching relational database queries and session state.
Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) at the database layer for in-memory microsecond read caching of DynamoDB tables.
AWS Global Accelerator to cache application database query responses at AWS edge locations.
Amazon MemoryDB for Redis to store static web images and reduce Amazon S3 bucket read latency.
Amazon ElastiCache for Redis deployed as a transparent caching proxy in front of both DynamoDB and static S3 content without application changes.

results.question_text: An enterprise is executing a large-scale migration of on-premises applications to AWS. The portfolio includes 100 Linux/Windows physical servers, a 20 TB Oracle database, and 50 TB of NFS file storage. The migration must minimize downtime and preserve file permissions. Which THREE AWS migration services should be deployed? (Select THREE.)
options: AWS Application Migration Service (AWS MGN) for continuous server block-level replication.
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) for continuous relational database replication to AWS.
AWS DataSync for online transfer of NFS file storage to Amazon EFS while preserving POSIX metadata.
AWS Transfer Family for SFTP to perform continuous live block-level replication of physical Linux and Windows servers.
AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized appliances to perform continuous real-time database replication for the 20 TB Oracle database.
AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway to migrate the NFS file storage while preserving local file permissions.
